purpose: Source evidence and completed source-domain joins for the original62 candidates, reconciled with the final native mechanism review. Final per-material classifications are recorded in closure-review.json.
standards: A positive route records an enabled gameplay producer, its input/condition, and a loading chain or mapped biome. It is static evidence, not an observation of running the game.
Cosmetic use is still use. Occurrence kind is recorded separately so a particle reference is not silently promoted to a terrain/reaction source.
Material definitions, output transformations requiring an unresolved seed, consumer-only lists, entity tags, audio paths and filenames are not independent sources.
A directory name such as temp, _workdir, test or trailer does not establish that an asset is unreachable.
Unused classifications require the joined source/native review in closure-review.json and the pinned executable/data corpus; source-name absence alone is not a certification.
scannerCorrections: Enabled VegetationComponent.tree_material and LooseGroundComponent.chunk_material were omitted by the previous generic producer regex.
Explosion config spark_material was omitted; glass has a real potion-break particle use.
EntityConvertToMaterial and ConvertEverythingToGold are producer API calls omitted by the previous attribute-only scanner.
A file reference or positive spawn-table weight is not proof that the callback is invoked; marker colors and biome mapping need to be checked.
A visual-file naming suffix is not the decisive evidence; the LoadPixelScene parameter receiving the image determines its role.
The prior description of trailer_text as engine solid was wrong; resolved engine data says cell_type=liquid and liquid_static=true.

corpusBindings.canonicalEncoding: UTF-8 JSON.stringify of an array of [relativePath, lowercaseHexSha256] pairs, sorted by relativePath with JavaScript UTF-16 code-unit order (a < b), with no trailing newline.
corpusBindings.fileHashNormalization: Hash raw file bytes. Do not normalize CRLF, whitespace, PNG encoding, or binary content.
corpusBindings.pathNormalization: Forward slashes; paths are relative to the noita-sources root and retain their data/ or noita_bin/mods/nightmare/ prefix. No leading slash, dot segment, or case normalization.

dataText.selection: Every regular file recursively under data/ whose case-sensitive suffix matches .lua, .xml, .txt, .csv, .frag or .vert.

dataImages.selection: Every regular file recursively under data/ whose case-sensitive suffix is .png or .plz, including unsupported shader images, blank placeholders and generated icons.

nightmare.selection: Every regular file recursively under noita_bin/mods/nightmare/, regardless of suffix; includes all source, images and metadata.

dataDirectoryMembership.canonicalEncoding: UTF-8 JSON.stringify of every regular-file data/-prefixed path sorted in JavaScript UTF-16 code-unit order; no trailing newline.
dataDirectoryMembership.purpose: Also invalidate if a new differently cased suffix or uninspected file kind appears in the data tree.
